C0784.title: Trivy Supply Chain Attack: Malicious Binaries Distributed via Official Channel
C0784.summary: In March 2026, Aqua Security disclosed that a threat actor used compromised credentials to publish a malicious Trivy v0.69.4 release and retarget multiple trivy-action and setup-trivy tags to credential-stealing malware. On March 22, malicious Docker Hub images were also published. Aqua said the payload collected environment variables, CI/CD credentials, cloud tokens, and other secrets for exfiltration, and advised users to revoke affected releases and action tags. NVD tracks the incident as CVE-2026-33634.
